prompts: Use case: style-transfer. Input1 is exact pose reference original front-facing 16-pose mechanical dragon sheet. Input2 is STYLE reference: the crisp detailed angular mechanical armor of the left-facing original. Produce ONLY the four front-facing poses from ROW 1 of Input1 (frames 1 through 4), rearranged into a 2x2 sheet in the same reading order. Every pose must match its corresponding original front pose exactly; do not use side poses. Ready stance, anticipation crouch, deep crouch, initial liftoff. Four FULL BODY sprites only, each large around 400 pixels wide in a 1024x1024 or larger sheet with generous 40px transparent margins. Highest attention to small crisp segmented armor, dark thin sharp metal seams and tiny controlled highlights matching Input2. FIVE distinct dragon heads: viewer-left WHITE, BLUE, crowned RED center, GREEN, VIOLET. White head must not become a second blue head. Same silver/dark charcoal armored body with gold claws and accents, deep red wing membranes, segmented tail. True pixel-art textures, precise angular pixel clusters, high detail, NOT smooth cartoon illustration, NOT glossy rounded vector art. NO glow, NO bloom, NO colored fringe, NO pale halo, NO rim-light aura, no blurred or feathered edges. Fully opaque character interior and tight clean transparent outside silhouette. Preserve pose proportions and head shapes. Neutral color value matching Input2, not oversaturated. No ground/shadow/VFX, no text.
